name: T-SP
description: T-SP was a Utility Tug in use by a Rebel Alliance outpost during the Galactic Civil War within an Imperial simulation. During an Imperial torpedo attack by Alpha Squadron TIE Bombers, T-SP attempted to board one of the Class-A cargo containers along with fellow Utility Tug T-ST. However, while trying to board the containers, the two utility tugs were destroyed along with the rest of the outpost's complement.

data.name: T-SP
data.destroyed: Sometime during the Galactic Civil War
